datasets.name: mnt_kpi
queryLines: WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND data BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim) AS os_periodo, (SELECT count_if(NOT terminada) FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim) AS os_abertas, sum(valor) AS custo_total, try_divide(sum(valor), greatest(datediff(least(:data_fim, current_date()), :data_inicio) + 1, 1)) AS custo_dia, sum(CASE WHEN origem IN ('Peças', 'Serviços de terceiros') THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS custo_manutencao, sum(CASE WHEN origem = 'Pneus' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS custo_pneus, sum(CASE WHEN origem = 'Combustível' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS custo_combustivel, count(DISTINCT bem) AS bens_com_custo FROM c

datasets.name: mnt_mes
queryLines: SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', dt_abertura) AS mes, tipo_manutencao, count(*) AS qtd_os FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: mnt_custo_mes
datasets.displayName: Frota - custo por mês e origem
queryLines: SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', data) AS mes, origem, sum(valor) AS custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND data BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: mnt_fam
queryLines: WITH f AS (SELECT coalesce(familia, 'Sem familia') AS familia, origem, sum(valor) AS custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND data BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2), t AS (SELECT familia FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(custo) DESC LIMIT 15) SELECT f.* FROM f JOIN t USING (familia)

datasets.name: mnt_cc
queryLines: WITH f AS (SELECT centro_custo, origem, sum(valor) AS custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND data BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY 1, 2), t AS (SELECT centro_custo FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(custo) DESC LIMIT 15) SELECT f.* FROM f JOIN t USING (centro_custo)

datasets.name: mnt_bem
queryLines: WITH c AS (SELECT bem, max(CASE WHEN bem_nome LIKE concat(bem, '%') THEN bem_nome ELSE concat_ws(' - ', bem, bem_nome) END) AS bem_desc, max(familia) AS familia, sum(valor) AS custo, sum(CASE WHEN origem = 'Peças' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS custo_pecas, sum(CASE WHEN origem = 'Serviços de terceiros' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS custo_terceiros, sum(CASE WHEN origem = 'Pneus' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS custo_pneus, sum(CASE WHEN origem = 'Combustível' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS custo_combustivel, sum(CASE WHEN origem = 'Combustível' THEN quantidade ELSE 0 END) AS litros FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND data BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY bem), o AS (SELECT bem, count(*) AS qtd_os FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY bem), k AS (SELECT bem, sum(km_rodados) AS km_rodados FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_km_mes WHERE mes BETWEEN date_trunc('MONTH', :data_inicio) AND :data_fim GROUP BY bem), r AS (SELECT c.*, coalesce(o.qtd_os, 0) AS qtd_os, k.km_rodados, try_divide(c.custo, greatest(datediff(least(:data_fim, current_date()), :data_inicio) + 1, 1)) AS custo_dia, try_divide(c.custo, k.km_rodados) AS custo_por_km, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.custo DESC) AS ranking FROM c LEFT JOIN o ON o.bem = c.bem LEFT JOIN k ON k.bem = c.bem) SELECT * FROM r WHERE ranking <= 50 ORDER BY ranking

datasets.name: mnt_detalhe
datasets.displayName: Frota - detalhamento do custo por bem
queryLines: WITH d AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN bem_nome LIKE concat(bem, '%') THEN bem_nome ELSE concat_ws(' - ', bem, bem_nome) END AS bem_desc FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND data BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim), r AS (SELECT bem, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(valor) DESC) AS ranking FROM d GROUP BY bem) SELECT d.filial, d.centro_custo, d.bem, d.bem_desc, d.familia, d.data, date_trunc('MONTH', d.data) AS mes, d.origem, d.documento, d.descricao, d.quantidade, d.valor, try_divide(d.valor, greatest(datediff(least(:data_fim, current_date()), :data_inicio) + 1, 1)) AS valor_dia, r.ranking FROM d JOIN r ON r.bem = d.bem WHERE r.ranking <= 50 ORDER BY r.ranking, d.data, d.documento

datasets.name: mnt_atip
queryLines: SELECT * FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os_atipicas WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim ORDER BY z_score DESC LIMIT 100

datasets.name: mnt_ccs
queryLines: SELECT centro_custo FROM (SELECT 'Todos' AS centro_custo UNION SELECT centro_custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os UNION SELECT centro_custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos) WHERE centro_custo IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN centro_custo = 'Todos' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, centro_custo

datasets.name: filiais
queryLines: SELECT filial FROM (SELECT 'Todas' AS filial UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_custos UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_mnt_os_atipicas) WHERE filial IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN filial = 'Todas' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, filial

lines: **Custo da frota** = peças + pneus + serviços de terceiros das OS + combustível dos abastecimentos. **Custo/dia** = custo ÷ dias do período (contados até hoje).

**Detalhamento:** clique numa barra do ranking **50 bens com maior custo** (ou escolha no filtro *Bem*) e a composição, a evolução mensal e a tabela de lançamentos mostram só aquele bem. Clique de novo para limpar.

**OS atípicas:** custo mais de 3 desvios-padrão acima da média do mesmo serviço (z-score > 3). **Filtros:** o período vale para a abertura da OS e a data do abastecimento; o centro de custo é o da OS / do abastecimento.
